text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًۭا

translations.asad: Oh, the chargers that run panting,

translations.sahih: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
Arriving thereby in the center collectively,

translations.asad: VERILY, towards his Sustainer man is most ungrateful
translations.sahih: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.

translations.asad: and to this, behold, he [himself] bears witness indeed:
translations.sahih: And indeed, he is to that a witness.

translations.asad: for, verily, to the love of wealth is he most ardently devoted.
translations.sahih: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.

text.arabic: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ

translations.asad: But does he not know that [on the Last Day,] when all that is in the graves is raised and brought out,
translations.sahih: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered

translations.asad: and all that is [hidden] in men's hearts is bared
translations.sahih: And that within the breasts is obtained,

translations.asad: that on that Day their Sustainer [will show that He] has always been fully aware of them?
translations.sahih: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
